title: Bayesian Equilibria of Heterogeneous Non-Atomic Routing Games with Private Information
summary: We study non-atomic Bayesian routing games whereby a transportation network is shared by two types of traffic: a coordinated fleet and a mass of selfish users. The links in the network are characterized by travel time functions that depend both on the aggregate flow on the link and on a random state of the world $W$ that, in general, is not directly observable. Rather, we assume that both the fleet coordinator and the selfish users know the prior distribution of $W$, observe (different) private messages that are correlated with $W$ and possibly among themselves, and make routing decisions…
